label: Controls for the typed LORD_2 and BLESSED_2 readings, checked
description: Nonvacuity: the directing bridge and the q.103 a.3 reading hold and a being has the nine, LORD_2 and BLESSED_2. Strictness: each new sense bridge holds where the old bridge it weakens fails (a cause of the being of all that governs nothing is not LORD_1; a perfect intellectual being not in act in understanding is not BLESSED_1). Necessity in these models: without directing, a being with the nine is not LORD_2; without act in understanding, it is not BLESSED_2. Sense mixing fails without the sense bridges: a being with the nine can be LORD_2 and BLESSED_2 and neither LORD_1 nor BLESSED_1. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; they show where each premise is needed, not that any premise is false.
